clarifications.timestamp_parse: reject malformed or missing timestamps; do not coerce
clarifications.epoch_definition: integer Unix seconds obtained by interpreting the timezone-naive local wall clock as UTC
clarifications.epoch_reason: the STHGCN source uses strftime('%s') on a naive datetime, which depends on host timezone; the portable definition preserves all within-city differences while removing host-timezone drift
clarifications.stable_order: local timestamp ascending, then immutable source ordinal ascending
clarifications.csv: UTF-8, RFC4180-compatible quoting, LF line endings, no index column
clarifications.json: UTF-8, sorted keys, two-space indentation, trailing LF
